claim: fasten SCREW PARTS checks a placed ISO 4762 screw against the parts it passes through: the head seated on a plane square to the axis with room in a coaxial counterbore, the shank clear along the clamp length, and the thread engaged in a coaxial internal thread of the same size for at least 1 x d in steel and 2 x d in aluminium (Nord-Lock); interference is also sampled inside the head and shank; a head clear of its seat, a head cut into it, a short or off-axis screw, a size mismatch and a missing material are each reported, and a node that is not a screw is refused

must: ^fasten screw 7 ISO 4762 M4x12 tip=\(15,15,-0\.8\) along=\(0,0,1\) parts 3 5$
^fasten head dk=7\.22 k=4: counterbore d=8 radial-clearance=0\.39 seat-gap=0 interference-samples=0/36 status=pass$
^fasten shank d=3\.9546 clamp=\[10\.8, 12\] through d=4\.5 radial-clearance=0\.2727 interference-samples=0/72 status=pass$
^fasten thread into M4x0\.7 6H \(thread m4\) node 5: engaged=10 required=unknown: no material is declared on node 5 .*status=not-analyzed$
engaged=10 required=4 \(1 x d in steel, S355 by designation; Nord-Lock 2015\) status=pass$
engaged=10 required=8 \(2 x d in aluminium, 6082-T6 by designation; Nord-Lock 2015\) status=pass$
^fasten head .*seat-gap=0\.5 \(the head is clear of its seat, not tightened\) interference-samples=0/36 status=fail$
^fasten head dk=7\.22 k=4: counterbore d=8 radial-clearance=0\.39 seat-gap=-0\.3 \(the head cuts into the seat\) interference-samples=0/36 status=fail$
^fasten thread: no internal M4x0\.7 thread in the listed parts is coaxial with the screw status=fail$
^fasten thread: no internal M3x0\.5 thread in the listed parts is coaxial with the screw status=fail$
